title: Daily Public Source Ingestion Contract
purpose: Define the first safe daily public-source ingestion slice for Notary Geek public law, agency, apostille, authentication, identity, and source-quality sources using reviewable Grok batch collection, OpenAI public-source normalization, and PR-gated publication.
coreRule: Every daily ingestion run must produce public-safe source infrastructure and reviewable evidence before publication. It must not produce legal advice, private operations, customer records, secrets, or auto-merged changes.

existingAzureFunctionTimer.timeZoneNote: Azure Functions timer expressions are treated as UTC unless the host is configured otherwise. Treat this as 09:17 UTC for source control planning.
existingAzureFunctionTimer.schedulerBoundary: Use the Azure timer as the active daily scheduler. Do not add a second daily submitter unless duplicate daily public-source runs are intentional.

githubActionsManualSubmitter.use: Repository-visible manual submitter that queues the public-source batch through the protected Azure Function endpoint and returns after queue submission.

pumpTimer.use: Poll queued public-knowledge jobs and refresh latest-run indexes/digests after asynchronous collection and normalization work.

dailyWindowPolicy.quotaBoundary: Track OpenAI public-sharing or daily free allocation usage as a daily window. Do not assume unused capacity carries forward.
dailyWindowPolicy.windowAnchorUtc: Record the first OpenAI public-normalization call time for the day as daily_window_anchor_utc until a more precise account-level reset signal is available.
dailyWindowPolicy.reservePolicy: Keep an operator-defined reserve for urgent public-safe normalization or regression checks; do not spend the entire daily allocation on unreviewed broad collection.

grokBatchJobContract.latencyBoundary: Batch collection is asynchronous and may take up to 24 hours. It is for broad public-source discovery, not urgent corrections.

instructions: Use only public source targets provided in the request.
Collect source metadata, official title, publisher, jurisdiction, source class, retrieval status, and route-relevant sections.
Do not create legal advice or final legal conclusions.
Do not include private customer data, private operating context, secrets, or credentials.

openAiNormalizationContract.keyBoundary: Use the dedicated daily-reset public data-sharing key for this public-safe lane. Do not fall back to a private or generic OpenAI API key when the public-source key is absent.
inputSources: existing Notary Geek law source index
existing public knowledge manifest and citation map
promptBoundary: Normalize public source metadata and route impact only.
Keep official text, bounded excerpt, summary, and Notary Geek interpretation separate.
Do not generate final legal advice.
Do not add a source record when source authority, source URL, retrieval status, or public-safety class is unclear.

requiredArtifacts.purpose: Public-safe daily target list chosen from official sources, high-value jurisdiction gaps, stale source records, and answer-engine regression failures.
Batch request metadata, provider batch id, custom_id map, submitted_at_utc, expected_completion_by_utc, and source-target count.
Fetch status, titles, publishers, public-source class, and warnings without secrets or private customer data.
OpenAI-normalized source records ready for human or model review before promotion.
Exact public corpus files to update, PR checklist, rollback file list, and review gates.

firstDryRunSlice.scope: Contract-only dry run plus one regression case and one source-target selection format. No live Grok batch was submitted and no OpenAI normalization call was made by this artifact.

sourceTargetSelection.reason: Use the existing public law source index as the first safe target selector before broad collection.
Use the existing source-cache posture to constrain normalization and prevent legal-advice overreach.

qualityGates: All source URLs must be public and allowed by the public-source boundary.
Every source record must identify publisher, jurisdiction or topic, source class, retrieval status, and freshness notes.
Official text or bounded excerpts must be visibly separate from summaries and Notary Geek interpretation.
No record may include customer facts, private correspondence, private operating strategy, secrets, raw credentials, provider dashboards, payment data, identity data, or raw prompts.
No generated output may be treated as final legal advice or controlling law.
Every promotion must be a draft PR with JSON parsing, diff check, and human or model review before merge.
Auto-merge is forbidden for this lane until a later reviewed contract explicitly changes that rule.

rules: Record estimates before submission and provider-reported usage after completion when available.
Treat each 24-hour reset window as a daily public-source allocation and schedule one useful public-safe run per day when work is available.
Keep budget notes public-safe and do not publish account identifiers, keys, billing screenshots, or private provider dashboard details.
Stop promotion if usage evidence is missing for a paid or capped run.

steps: Revert the draft PR or promotion commit before merge if quality gates fail.

If a merged source record is later found unsafe or wrong, open a corrective PR that removes the daily source-ingestion folder entries and any promoted manifest, citation-map, artifact-index, regression-matrix, or law-index references.
Preserve a public-safe correction note explaining the source-class or safety issue without exposing private data.
Do not delete provider usage ledgers or collection evidence unless they contain private data; redact and replace with a reviewed public-safe artifact instead.

officialProviderDocsReviewed.use: Public-sharing/data-sharing boundary and complimentary daily token context. Re-check before relying on account-specific allocation behavior.
Batch-processing concept and asynchronous public-source collection lane. Re-check exact API fields before submitting live batches.

allowed: official public law and agency sources
